title: Ask HN: Small product, single founder success stories?
guide_zh: 寻找单人创办、小产品起步的成功案例，看看不扩团队能走多远。
author: thunga
excerpt: I have read some small product, single founder success stories on HN over the last few years. Can you share some stories/links even though it has been shared before on an unrelated thread? On HN, patio11, edw519, peldi & jacques have all shared success stories before. I am interested to know more. EDIT : By success, I mean happiness in life & financial independence to do interesting things in life.

title: Ask PG: What has changed since you wrote Hackers and Painters in 2004?

title: Ask HN: I think My code isn't Good enough
guide_zh: 编程四五年后仍觉得代码不如别人，作者想知道如何面对和提升。
author: mabid
excerpt: I have been programming for the last 4-5 years but whenever I look at some good code written by some one else I always have this feeling that my code isnt good enough. By "good enough" I mean that my code isn't as beautiful(readable) and reusable. I always try to change the way i do things the next time but i keep getting this feeling. Do you guys ever fell like this and what you think I should do to improve on that ?

title: Ask HN: European startup looking for a service for recurring billing
guide_zh: 美国常用服务尚未覆盖欧洲，欧洲创业公司该选什么周期扣款方案？
author: davidvanleeuwen
excerpt: We love Stripe, Samurai, Braintree and services like that. Unfortunately, they're not available for companies outside of the US. Most people say that we need to use Paypal. But we prefer to work with Stripe for example, because it really looks like a great service and a service with a refreshing way of working with payments. Does anyone know or have experience with using a recurring service that is accessible for European companies?
